status.mockStyle: body { line-height: var(--leading-normal); } h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 { line-height: var(--leading-snug); } :root, [data-theme] { --gutter: clamp(1rem, 4vw, 3rem); } @media (max-width: 959px) { [data-story-grid] { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) !important; } } figure:has(> .fmp-caro-frame) > figcaption { flex-wrap: wrap !important; row-gap: var(--space-2) !important; } @media (min-width: 680px) { figure:has(> .fmp-caro-frame) > figcaption { padding-inline: 64px; } } @media (min-width: 1280px) { .fmp-caro-frame { margin-inline: -64px; } figure:has(> .fmp-caro-frame) > figcaption { padding-inline: 0; } }
status.mockStyleReason: The live site sets body and heading line-heights (base.css) and a live-tuned --gutter (tokens.css); the mock export has none of them. All predate this handoff, which says tokens are unchanged. Below 960px the mock's story grid column is a bare 1fr, so the screens strip stretches it to 870px and the page scrolls sideways at 375; the build uses minmax(0, 1fr), as the mock already does from 960px. The pipes v8 handoff makes every carousel figcaption wrap (gap space-2 space-4) so the dots drop below the counter on a phone, as Ben chose; this mock predates it. Carousel caption row aligned with the slides, and slides full width from 1280px with the chevrons in the margin (Ben, Pipes PRD decision 16).
